front.title: Rule Provenance for Autonomous AI Agent Audit Records

abstract.t: This document describes an experimental profile of the Agent Audit Trail format for AI agents. The profile records the rules an agent operates under: each version of each rule, who set and approved it, and which rules were in force when a decision was made. It keeps a decision separate from any later approval or override, binds it to the exact request, and requires that records of consequential actions go to a recorder independent of the operator and be anchored in a public log. It also sets out what these records can and cannot prove.
